result.summary: The page is generally polished, but there are visible layout and readability issues around the horizontally clipped carousels, the fixed bottom navigation, and the promotional banner contrast.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar overlaps the second restaurant card, cutting off its image and likely hiding the card's remaining content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable page content or ensure the final card can scroll fully above the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: The category chips and restaurant carousel cards are visibly cut off at the right edge, including a partial category chip and truncated restaurant title.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has intentional spacing and a visible scroll affordance, or constrain the content so items do not appear accidentally clipped.

issues.description: The white promotional text on the very pale green banner has low visual contrast, especially the secondary line.
issues.suggestion: Use darker text or a darker banner treatment to meet readable contrast standards while preserving the promotional styling.
